name: A Bad Egg
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Level 60 instead of 47. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.offerRewardText: I am afraid I have bad news for you, adventurer. This egg is too far gone. I can take it from you so that it may be disposed of properly.Please don't be discouraged; we cannot save them all. If you find yourself in Feralas again, please try again. Bring another egg for the Super Egg-O-Matic!
narrative.requestItemsText: These are the eggs that cannot be saved -- they will never hatch.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 47 to 60, 4,200 XP in all.
